semantics.rust_signature: fn cast_to_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, input: &Tensor, dtype: DType, device: DeviceId, non_blocking: bool, copy: bool, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, OperatorIndirectionError>
semantics.mutation_rule: input storage is immutable and conversion publishes only a complete output
semantics.alias_rule: same dtype and device with copy false preserves storage identity; every other case returns fresh canonical storage
semantics.shape_rule: preserves rank, dimensions, and logical element order including checked strided input traversal
semantics.dtype_rule: all canonical scalar dtypes use DType decode and encode semantics; complex-to-real uses the real component and complex-to-complex preserves both components
semantics.layout_rule: logical strided input is accepted and converted output is contiguous
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is exact native; all uncertified devices return typed unavailable
semantics.numeric_rule: conversion uses checked integer bounds, canonical float and float8 codecs, and canonical Boolean conversion
semantics.tolerance: bit-exact for exactly representable values and canonical rounding for narrowed formats
semantics.cancellation_points: before allocation, every 256 logical elements, after the backend fence, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: identity for differentiable floating casts with the inverse storage cast; integer and Boolean casts are non-differentiable
semantics.jvp_rule: floating tangents use the same destination cast; integer and Boolean casts have no tangent
